Iran Tensions Disrupt Global Shipping and Markets

Amid escalating tensions with the United States, Iran has threatened to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed. This stance has led to record high fees for passage through the Panama Canal due to shipping disruptions. In the Red Sea's Bab Al-Mandeb Strait, a Houthi attack on a commercial ship resulted in the deaths of four crew members and two Yemeni rescuers. These developments have also impacted global markets, with U.S. stocks falling following Iran's threats regarding the Strait of Hormuz.
